t.E432.agn: In 2015 EFSA set a group acceptable daily intake (ADI) of 25 mg/kg body weight for polysorbates (E432–E436); it found no concern regarding genotoxicity, carcinogenicity or developmental toxicity. It noted that intake in high-consuming young children approaches the limit.
t.E432.body: It is absorbed to a limited extent in the gut; it breaks down into sorbitan and fatty acids.
t.E432.eval: The fatty acid source may be vegetable or animal (including beef/pork); the source is often not stated on the label.
t.E432.prod: It is produced by the chemical reaction of fatty acids and sorbitol with ethylene oxide.
t.E432.summary: A synthetic emulsifier from the polysorbate group. It allows oil and water to mix; it is used in ice cream, sauces and cake mixes.
t.E432.what: It keeps oil and water mixed (emulsifier).
